caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate object resembling a decorative lamp or ceremonial pedestal. At the top, there is a spherical glass or crystal element that is transparent with subtle gray shading and decorated with a shield motif, floral patterns, and circular forms arranged symmetrically in a ring. This spherical piece sits atop a gold-colored, fluted support with elaborate detailing and an intermediate gold section featuring ornamental elements. The central column beneath is predominantly white with gray, yellow, and gold motifs that include vines and round shapes. The column transitions into a wide, square base, also featuring gold and white detailing with a decorative border. The composition uses light, naturalistic colors with gold being prominent in the decorative elements while the background is plain and beige, with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Table Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
